p: this: He will intreat how God governs the world by his providence which cannot be perceived by the judgment of the flesh.
fear in the days of evil: Though wickedness reigns and enemies rage, seeing God will execute his judgments against the wicked at a suitable time.
wealth: To trust in riches is madness, seeing they can neither restore life, nor prolong it.
precious: That is, so rare or not to be found, as prophecy was precious in the days of Eli, 1Sa 3:1.
and it ceaseth for ever: Meaning it is impossible to live for ever: also that life and death are only in God's hands.
die: In that that death makes no difference between the persons.
others: That is, not to their children, but to strangers. Yet the wicked profit not by these examples, but still dream of immortality on earth.
beasts that perish: Concerning the death of the body.
approve their sayings: They speak and do the same thing that their fathers did.
Like sheep they are laid in: As sheep are gathered into the fold, so shall they be brought to the grave.
death shall feed on them: Because they have no part of life everlasting.
morning: Christ's coming is as the morning, when the elect will reign with Christ their head over the wicked.
men will praise thee: The flatterers praise them who live in delight and pleasures.
He shall go to the generation: And not pass the term appointed for life.
they shall never see light: Both they and their fathers will live here but a while and at length die forever.
understandeth not: He condemns man's ingratitude, who having received excellent gifts from God, abuses them like a beast to his own condemnation.
